The remaining 12 MW is Maurienne’s Mont de Bézard II – Les Renardières (Gourgançon and Semoine, 6 turbines and 2 delivery points, in service since September 2007, new machines from 21 Mar 2023; DREAL inspection reports)', 'https://www.georisques.gouv.fr/webappReport/ws/installations/inspection/my3Ga9DAqq5N5aNKpClmt5bw0mMSM4p4', mw=12, year=2007, note=True)
note_zh: Gourgançon 48 MW＝鎮內 2021 年前 4 個 12 MW 併網點的合計（GEM 依 ENGIE 2019 年資產表）；其中 36 MW 已在 Mont De Bézard（2007 一期）與 Le Mont Grignon，剩下 12 MW 是 Maurienne 的 Mont de Bézard II – Les Renardières。
note_en: Gourgançon 48 MW = the commune’s four pre-2021 12 MW delivery points (GEM, from ENGIE’s 2019 asset list); 36 MW of it is already in Mont De Bézard (2007 phase) and Le Mont Grignon, leaving Maurienne’s 12 MW Mont de Bézard II – Les Renardières.
why: The register row for the remaining 12 MW is “Confidentiel”; it is attributed to the Maurienne park because that is the only other park the DREAL reports place in Gourgançon with a 2007 start. Its capacity after the 2023 repowering is not stated (register still 12 MW). Optional: rename='Mont de Bézard II – Les Renardières wind farm'. Owner ENGIE kept (GEM source: ENGIE FY2019 analyst pack). Not to be confused with Innergex’s Les Renardières (21 MW, 2017), a separate record 9 km south. note_zh: GEM 的「Vluchtheuvel」應是 Vluchthaven：RVO 把 Neeltje Jans Buitenhaven（含 Vluchthaven）21.5 MW 記在 2021 年完成（Noordland Buitenhaven 2 × 4.3＋Vluchthaven 3 × 4.3 MW＝21.5 MW，nl.wikipedia）；Binnenhaven 另有紀錄。
note_en: GEM’s “Vluchtheuvel” is presumably Vluchthaven: RVO books Neeltje Jans Buitenhaven (incl. Vluchthaven), 21.5 MW, as completed in 2021 (Noordland Buitenhaven 2 × 4.3 + Vluchthaven 3 × 4.3 MW = 21.5 MW per nl.wikipedia); Binnenhaven is a separate record.
why: nl.wikipedia dates the three Vluchthaven V136 units to 2022 and the two Noordland Buitenhaven units to 2021; RVO (primary) counts all 21.5 MW as realised in 2021, so 2021 is used. The name match (Vluchtheuvel ≈ Vluchthaven) is an inference; the capacity (22 vs 21.5 MW) and place fit. [Main session, round 20: not written — RVO (2021) and Wikipedia (Vluchthaven 2022) disagree, and the name match is inferred.]
